notes: Seneca Guns NC/VA coast — Persistent unexplained booms. USGS documented. No seismic signature in most cases. Possible shallow marine sources.
Barisal Guns Bangladesh — Historical persistent booms. Documented in scientific literature. Ganges delta sediment liquefaction proposed.
Mistpouffers Belgium/Netherlands — Historical North Sea coast booms. Coastal atmospheric effects proposed but incomplete explanation.
Clintonville WI 2012 swarm — Four consecutive nights of booms. USGS seismograph showed tiny tremors. Cause officially undetermined.
Brevard County FL — Booms reported coincident with military exercise. SpaceX Falcon 9 sonic boom trajectory confirmed in some events.
East Bay CA booms — Multiple reports no seismic correlation. Possible military aircraft.
Seattle WA post-quake booms — Following M3.9 but some booms without seismic match. Puget Lowland geology.
Los Angeles CA booms — F-35B test flight confirmed by Edwards AFB after media inquiry. Classified exercise timing.
San Diego CA — Multiple booms confirmed as USS Ronald Reagan strike group exercises.
Boston MA area booms — Multiple 911 calls no seismic signal. Cause undetermined.
